name: Question 14
problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 3 & 10 & -12 & 14 \\ 2 & 3 & -19 & 15\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.
worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 3 & 10 & -12 & 14 \\ 2 & 3 & -19 & 15\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -4 \\ 2 & 3 & -19 & 15\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & -3 & -9 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The corresponding system is now

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+3y-5z=6 \\ 0x+y+3z=-4 \\ 0x+0y+0z=-9\end{aligned}
$$

Since there are no such numbers $x,y,z$ that form a solution of the final equation $0x+0y+0z=-9,$ we can conclude that our system has no solution.

Question 14

Consider the augmented matrix M given by M=[13−56310−121423−1915]. Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce M to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

a
[2−2y−6z4zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
b
No solution
c
[12−2y4−3zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
d
[6+3y−5z−4−2zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
e
[6−3y+5z−4−3zz],z∈(−∞,∞)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Reducing M to echelon form, we have

M∼[13−56310−121423−1915]R2:=R2−3R1∼[13−56013−423−1915]R3:=R3−2R1∼[13−56013−40−3−93]R3:=R3+3R2∼[13−56013−4000−9].

The corresponding system is now

{x+3y−5z=60x+y+3z=−40x+0y+0z=−9

Since there are no such numbers x,y,z that form a solution of the final equation 0x+0y+0z=−9, we can conclude that our system has no solution.
